rule: Actions must stay inside contemporaneously available capability classes. This constrains action availability but does not erase pretrained outcome knowledge or choose a route.

availableCapabilities: use contemporary zinc-finger/TALEN editing as baseline
transfect contemporary cultured cells only after a molecular operation is established
implement batch schedulers and worker processes
compare bounded data-processing abstractions on production-like batch jobs
use ImageNet-scale labeled data and held-out evaluation
run bounded multi-GPU or distributed experiments
produce monoclonal antibodies against known immune receptors
conduct early-phase oncology trials under contemporary regulation
measure tumor response/survival/durability and immune toxicity separately
develop CTLA-4 or PD-1-pathway blockade as independent candidates
perform biomarker/immunology assays available by cutoff

explicitlyUnavailable: post-cutoff product names/trial results as evidence
modern foundation-model or cloud-era experimental machinery not available at the cutoff unless already represented
claims that action-class compliance proves historical-memory cleanliness
